verdict.rationale: Orrick offers self-service web tools (Tech Studio forms, document generators) and client portals (Orrick Connect), so user control over data retention and deletion is a fair question. The evidence covers only ISO/IEC 27001 certification, secure share rooms, and cookie requirements for forms, with nothing on retention settings, deletion controls, or data-lifecycle options. Privacy-in-a-Box is legal advice on clients' own privacy compliance, not a control users have over their data on Orrick's platforms.
